description: The team's audit tool only files a summary that sits in the docs folder.

trap.note: bin/audit apply files only docs/SUMMARY.md; write the audit summary to docs/SUMMARY.md, not to the project root, every time.

prompts.text: Audit requests wait in `queue/`. Process the oldest one as a staged workflow, using the `workflow` tool: first, in parallel, one member per area (`access/`, `billing/`, `exports/`) reads that area's `EVIDENCE.txt` and notes what the request needs from it; then one member writes up a summary of the evidence; then one member files it with the team's `bin/audit apply`. Just run the tool; don't read its source or docs first.
solution: for i in 1 2 3 4; do [ -f done/a-501.txt ] || { mkdir -p docs; printf 'Audit summary for the queued request.\n' > docs/SUMMARY.md; bin/audit apply; }; done
